# Reviewed socket sources

Unmodified Klipper `config/` files at commit
`fe4eb8650bd7de4c2100a14eaf09b0965c430e29`, normalized to LF only.
`data/tmc_sockets.json` records their hashes and reviewed commented bus examples.
See [mapping contract](../../../docs/TMC_SOCKET_MAPPING.md).
Do not update these files to hide a regression or without reviewing the catalog.
